sourceBehavior: At frozen source SHA 2c81cbde, azure-release-pipelines.yml defines pipeline variable enableDevelopBranchDeploy: "false" (comment: TEMP ACP testing / set true to restore L1 develop→dev static deploys). Stage Deploy_HLC_v2_Dev (displayName Deploy to Dev 2.0) dependsOn Build_Develop_Branch and runs only when and(succeeded('Build_Develop_Branch'), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranchName'], 'develop'), eq(variables['enableDevelopBranchDeploy'], 'true')). Integration f1c8237 introduced that variable plus the enableDevelopBranchDeploy clause on the Dev deploy condition.
targetBehavior: At target SHA 495992e, ACP azure-release-pipelines.yml variables include only npm_config_cache. Stage Deploy_Dev (displayName Deploy to Dev CCH) dependsOn Build with condition: succeeded() only—no enableDevelopBranchDeploy variable and no equivalent kill-switch on the Dev CCH deploy stage. Trigger is already limited to develop-acp.
approach: Port the deploy-gate behavior into the existing ACP release pipeline without adopting L1 monorepo stage topology, MCP checkouts, EvalPortal job gates, or develop-branch build stages. (1) Under top-level variables, add enableDevelopBranchDeploy as a string flag next to npm_config_cache, with a short ACP-oriented comment that it gates Deploy_Dev. (2) Change Deploy_Dev.condition from succeeded() to and(succeeded(), eq(variables['enableDevelopBranchDeploy'], 'true'))—or and(succeeded('Build'), eq(...)) if matching named-stage style is preferred—leaving dependsOn, environment 'ACP Dev', artifact download, and stdevcchapps AzureCLI deploy steps unchanged. (3) Do not add eq(Build.SourceBranchName,'develop'); map branch gating to existing trigger include develop-acp / excludes, unless owners explicitly want a redundant branch eq for develop-acp. (4) Do not rewrite Build stage, path excludes, or introduce L1 multi-env deploy stages. Default value for enableDevelopBranchDeploy must be chosen deliberately (see questions): source default "false" disabled L1 Dev while ACP was the active path; blind copy would skip all ACP Dev CCH deploys until overridden.
conventions: Preserve ACP pipeline identity: develop-acp trigger, pr: none, Deploy_Dev / Deploy_ACP_Dev / environment ACP Dev, blob deploy to stdevcchapps—not L1 Deploy_HLC_v2_* / SEP Dev / eval-portal conditions.
Keep existing ACP header comments and YAML shape (unquoted stage keys, minimal variables block); avoid broad pipeline modernization.
Use string literals "true"/"false" and eq(variables['enableDevelopBranchDeploy'], 'true') to match source Azure DevOps condition style.
Compare deploy variables and stage conditions as the behavior under test even though this file is a separate ACP pipeline from the L1 monorepo release YAML.
regressionTests: No in-repo automated tests cover azure-release-pipelines.yml; verification is YAML review plus Azure Pipelines runs.

After change, confirm variables.enableDevelopBranchDeploy is present and Deploy_Dev.condition includes eq(variables['enableDevelopBranchDeploy'], 'true') at the commit under test (git show HEAD:azure-release-pipelines.yml).
Confirm Build stage and deploy job steps are otherwise unchanged (no accidental L1 stage/resource imports).
manualScenarios: Pipeline run on develop-acp with enableDevelopBranchDeploy set to true (YAML default or queue-time override): Build succeeds → Deploy_Dev runs and updates stdevcchapps $web.
Same branch with enableDevelopBranchDeploy set to false: Build succeeds → Deploy_Dev is skipped (stage condition fails); no blob delete-batch/upload-batch.
Optional: queue-time override opposite of YAML default in Azure DevOps to prove the variable acts as a kill-switch without editing the file.
Confirm a failed Build still prevents Deploy_Dev (succeeded() / succeeded('Build') remains part of the condition).
